title: sync script: no preflight for timeout/opencode; rc=127 silently degrades all conflicts to manual on hosts lacking timeout (macOS path)
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 3.8. :110 timeout is not in base macOS installs; on such hosts every single-file conflict silently takes the manual path with only a log line as signal. Fix: preflight 'command -v timeout opencode' at script start with a loud diagnostic.
